title: Mayan hip-hop music - Wikipedia
text: Mayan Hip-hop is a sub-genre of Hip-hop and rap music which entails the use of Mayan indigenous languages and themes in Hip-hop. The sub-genre was created by Latin Hip-hop artists who wanted to draw attention to Indigenous rights and language preservation.
